statement: The taker (not the maker) fills a whole ratio 1..65535 of what remains, while the offer is live in the judge's view. Each leg is floor(amount * ratio / 65535) on its own, the arithmetic of DeltaTransformer's applySwap, so a fill the chain would settle at the same ratio moves the same amounts. A fill that takes nothing of a leg is refused (fill_too_small): every fill is a trade. The whole fill (65535) drops the offer.
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01

killers.name: account/swap R-SWAP-FILL the taker fills a ratio of what remains, each leg rounded down on its own
